Tingen lies in another world: a foggy industrial city where three church teams hire clerks who may later be offered a Beyonder potion; a civil post under a new name is open too. Pick a life to see how it begins.

Year: 1349, early Tingen. Also listed: 1352 and later. Not written yet: later years need their own Tingen.

How you arrive: You wake in a local who has just died. Also listed: Brought over by someone's design, as in the books. Not written yet: that route brings pulls and claims the game has no rules for.

Host: An adult clerk. Also listed: A child or teenager. Not written yet: the church teams hire adult clerks, and young hosts need lives of their own.

as a Nighthawk probationer. You are a clerk of the supervised workroom in early Tingen, on the probationer branch under Warden Hale. The clerk's own purse of 2 pounds is yours; the money you held before crossing stays behind.

as a Machinery team probationer. You are a clerk of the Steam and Machinery church's team in the university quarter, on the probationer track under its records officer. The Nighthawks are another church's team and another district. The clerk's own purse of 2 pounds is yours; the money you held before crossing stays behind.

as a Mandated Punisher probationer. You are a clerk of the Church of the Storm's Mandated Punishers at the docks, on the probationer track under the duty officer. The Nighthawks and the Machinery team hold other districts. The clerk's own purse of 2 pounds is yours; the money you held before crossing stays behind.

under a new identity as civil staff. An adult human clerk under a bought name. Of 29 pounds funded before entry, papers cost 8, clothes and goods 12, and one third-class passage 4; 5 remain, with no money debt. The money you held before crossing stays behind. The Nighthawk office offers 3 pounds a week, a five-year term and lifetime secrecy. A post brings no potion; church teams know your old ties. Later ocean passage needs an official certificate.
